rules.match: items[].code = the portal product code; model = the site product code
site_owns: active (a product missing from the feed was taken off the site)
rules.tiers: qty = the quantity a price starts at; unit = price per piece in USD; total = the price shown on the site for that quantity
rules.new_products: a code the portal does not have is created from the feed; its portal price starts as the site price until the portal sets its own
rules.sync: sync = false: an old site product without an MD code (KART-N, BRO…). The portal has its own item for it; do not import it. portal_hint = the likely portal model, to confirm in the portal
rules.bundle: offers (MD-OF-*): bundle = the pieces in one set or bundle, with the portal code when the piece is on the site
rules.price_owner: price_owner = portal: the portal sets the price (MD-TR-* from the supplier lists; MD-FL-* = the sum of its source items in the portal, Ammar 30 Oct). price_owner = site: the site price is the list price (new fragrances and apparel, offers MD-OF-*, desk sets MD-DS-*, print MD-PR-*, agenda MD-AG-*)
